answer: Require each agent to lock a non-refundable stake bond before it can transact, with earnings capped per bonded unit. Sybil armies then cost linearly: a thousand clones need a thousand bonds, no shortcut. Slashing burns the deposit of anyone caught colluding, keeping fraud profit below capital at risk. Reputation lives on a crystal-clear public ledger, so an attackers cheap identities erode like a wind-blown dune while honest history stands like seasoned timber.
